facts.text: I am thinking of training for a triathlon in the spring.
I have a busy schedule that includes tennis, biking, swimming, and yoga.
I already do yoga on Mondays and Wednesdays.
I want to incorporate strength training into my yoga sessions to focus on lower body and core exercises.
I want to incorporate high-intensity interval training (HIIT) into my strength training sessions.
I want my training to improve my power and endurance for tennis and biking.
I want to incorporate strength training exercises that target my core and glutes into my yoga sessions.
I want my core and glute training to improve my stability and power on the bike and tennis court.

keyphrases: busy schedule tennis biking swimming yoga
stability and power bike tennis court
